mods.name: Caerula Arbor Crop Compatibility
mods.description: Improves compatibility of configured crops with standard Minecraft crop automation by exposing the vanilla CropBlock contract where supported, while preserving native blockstate maturity properties and original crop behavior.

releases.notes:
- Keep existing vanilla and other-mod crop/seed tag entries when generating configured tags, and enable the generated configuration datapack by default.
- Preserve built-in Caerula Arbor seed mappings when entries are disabled, removed, or contain an invalid seed override.
- Separate crop-tag, seed-tag, age-property, and maximum-age validation.
- Apply an explicit max_age only when the configured age property is valid; otherwise derive the maximum from the native property after fallback.
- Use Minecraft 1.20.1-compatible registry APIs and stricter JSON validation.

mods.name: Caerula Arbor Crop Compatibility
mods.description: Improves compatibility of configured crops with standard Minecraft crop automation by exposing the vanilla CropBlock contract where supported, while preserving native blockstate maturity properties and original crop behavior.

releases.notes:
- Crop maximum age is now detected dynamically from Caerula Arbor's block state.
- Improved crop compatibility while preserving Caerula Arbor's original blockstate behavior.
- Specifically treated Harvest With Ease compatibility.
- Crop compatibility semantics are configurable per entry in config/caerula_crop_compat/crops.json.

mods.name: Caerula Arbor Crop Compatibility
mods.description: Improves compatibility of six Caerula Arbor crops with standard Minecraft crop automation by exposing the vanilla CropBlock and age contracts while preserving the original Caerula Arbor behavior.

readmeSummary: A lightweight compatibility add-on for Caerula Arbor on Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge).
